artworks.title: Prospetto della Chiesa del SS. Rosario detta de' Gesuati
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural view centered on a church building with a prominent dome. The perspective is from a lower angle, highlighting the church's grandeur. The structures dominate the scene, and the etching technique creates a monochromatic palette with intricate details. Several figures are near the church, and statues and sculptural details are visible. Additional architectural elements are seen in the distance, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Prospetto della Chiesa del SS. Salvatore
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a straight-on perspective of an ornate building, likely a church, with a grand entrance centered. The sky serves as the backdrop with no visible horizon, and a tall obelisk stands to the left. The building's intricate details are highlighted through engraving, creating depth and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly black and gray, typical of engravings, lending a timeless quality. A fountain with spouting water and a few figures are visible in the foreground. On the right, arched structures suggest architectural ruins or aqueducts, extending into the background.

artworks.title: Veduta del Prospetto della Chiesa del S. Francesco
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of an architectural facade, likely of a church or cathedral. The horizon is low in the composition, running close to the base of the building, with a body of water and sailing vessels in the distance. The artwork uses fine-line etching techniques for detailed textures of the building, clouds, and water. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black, giving a historical feel. Figures are depicted in the plaza, adding a lively touch to the architectural setting.

artworks.title: The Angel of the Annunciation
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an incomplete view of a person's body from the waist up. The person is seated or kneeling with one knee bent, leaning forward slightly. They have long, wavy hair, and are holding a staff in their left hand. Their facial features are detailed with soft expressions, and they are wearing a voluminous robe fastened with two circular clasps at the chest. The background is plain and undetailed.

artworks.title: Tantalus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolors, heightened in gold, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann and Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Young Woman with a Bowl, Seated Outdoors
artworks.medium: black, red, and white chalks over graphite on blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a figure in a seated position, reclining against a stone surface. The figure's head is turned slightly towards the viewer, with softly defined facial features. The hair is styled in an updo with waves falling around the face. The clothing is draped in a classical style, featuring flowing robes with a dual color scheme of white and warm orange. The person has one arm resting on the stone behind them and the other arm is outstretched, holding a shallow dish or plate. The background features informal sketching of foliage and rock formations, giving the impression of an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: An Ancient Forum with Porticos
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural structure. The image shows a complex and grandiose building featuring multiple arches, columns, and detailed ornamentation. The structure is depicted from an angle, revealing its facade adorned with sculptures and statues. The composition shows tiered steps and detailed perspectives emphasizing the scale and intricacy of the design. The use of lines and shading creates depth in this elaborate architectural depiction.

artworks.title: Carro di Cerere (Chariot of Ceres)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a celestial scene depicting a chariot drawn by a two-headed dragon. The dragon has green scales and outstretched wings, pulling the chariot against a cloudy backdrop. In the chariot sits a figure in robes holding a sickle and a sheaf of wheat. The chariot has an ornate wheel. The composition uses flowing lines and the background is cloudy.

artworks.title: The Awakening of Venus
artworks.medium: pastel manner printed in black, red, white, yellow, and blue on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining on a bed draped with fabric. She has a serene expression, with her legs extended and torso slightly turned. Her right arm supports her, and she holds flowers near her hip. Her hair is styled in loose curls with flowers. A white dove rests near her hand. The woman is partially draped with fabric, with much of her upper body exposed. The background features draped fabric, creating an ornate setting. The color palette is soft and pastel, adding to the ethereal quality of the image.

artworks.title: A Bear Hunt
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Flipart after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (proof)
artworks.dimensions:
plate (trimmed within plate mark at bottom): 50.9 x 37.2 cm (20 1/16 x 14 5/8 in.)
sheet: 52 x 39.6 cm (20 1/2 x 15 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene of a hunt in a rugged landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is towards the upper third of the image, showing hills or mounds in the distance. The etching is detailed, showing figures and animals engaged in hunting. The lines are fine and dense, conveying movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray from the black and white etching emphasizing detailed linework. In the foreground, figures and animals are actively engaged, while the background adds depth. The sky is pale, contrasting with the bustling scene below.

artworks.title: L'Assomption de Hannele Mattern; En l'attendant
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of Martin Atlas by his friends
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene involving a reclining hand holding a flower and a ghostly figure with long flowing hair. The painting on the left shows a figure reclining, holding a flower towards a ghostly silhouette of a figure with flowing hair. The composition utilizes a limited color palette with shades of green and beige. The illustration is bordered by text. This art style reflects the aesthetic influence of Art Nouveau.

artworks.title: A Rustic Barn
artworks.medium: etching on light blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from an elevated viewpoint. The sky with cloud-like strokes and a thatched roof cottage are visible. Figures are standing near steps on the left, and detailed tree outlines are seen on the right. The monochromatic color palette highlights the ink line details on the paper background.

artworks.title: Two Travelers Passing by an Old Oak Tree
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.6 x 13.7 cm (5 3/8 x 5 3/8 in.)
sheet: 18 x 21.2 cm (7 1/16 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a detailed etching of a landscape seen through an oval-shaped frame. There is a textured tree with intricate leaves and branches in the foreground. The horizon shows hills and a small building on the right. The etching uses fine lines to create texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in black and white, creating contrast. In the scene, there is a shepherd with a flock of sheep under the tree.

artworks.title: Young Girl Reading "Héloise and Abélard"
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black, blue, and red
artworks.dimensions:
image: 19.8 × 15.1 cm (7 13/16 × 5 15/16 in.)
sheet ((trimmed within plate mark)): 21.9 × 16.6 cm (8 5/8 × 6 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated and turned towards the right side of the frame. She is reading a book held in her gloved hands. Her hair is styled elegantly with pink adornments, likely flowers or ribbons. She wears luxurious clothing with ruffled trims and a high collar in muted tones highlighted with hints of blue and pink to match her hair accessories. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: Young Woman Seated on a Bed
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (5th framing line): 40.9 x 29.2 cm (16 1/8 x 11 1/2 in.)
image: 35.5 x 23.8 cm (14 x 9 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The lithograph depicts a seated woman, with most of her body visible. She is seated in a relaxed position, slightly reclined, with her left arm over her knee and her right hand supporting her head. She is looking at a child beside her, with a gentle expression. Her hair is in a loose bun, with tendrils framing her face. She wears a loose garment that drapes over her body. A draped fabric surrounds her, hinting at a canopy bed. A small cat is near her feet. The background shows folds of curtain-like fabric, providing depth to the image.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 27.7 x 23.1 cm (10 7/8 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image portrays two figures from the waist up. One figure is a woman seated, holding a baby. The woman has a cloth wrapped around her head and wears flowing robes. The baby has curly hair and is looking outward. The background is simple with shading. There are no visible objects or jewelry in the image.

artworks.title: The Steps at Saint-Cloud
artworks.medium: albumen silver print

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands as Christ Is Led Away
artworks.medium: monochrome oil on paper laid down on mount
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in different poses. One figure is sitting on a throne at the top right, partially obscured, with a draped material hanging behind them. Other figures are around the throne, depicted in dark tones. Some figures hold objects like spears or staffs. The background features heavy, dark drapery creating a shadowy atmosphere. The scene suggests a dynamic moment with the figures engaged around the seated individual.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.medium: black chalk on tan prepared laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing with a vertical oval frame depicting three individuals in a natural setting. The central figure is sitting on the ground leaning back, supported by one arm. They appear shirtless with musculature visible and wear draped fabric around the waist. To the right is another figure partially clothed in flowing fabric from the waist down, sitting and leaning slightly towards the central figure with one arm extended. The hair of these figures appears simple, pulled back or short. In the upper left, a third figure stands draped in fabric from shoulders to feet with hands slightly raised or gesturing. The background features a natural scene with trees, foliage, and undulating terrain, creating a lush and textured environment. The drawing emphasizes line work and shading, giving a sense of classical or mythological themes.

artworks.title: The Artist's Studio
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white gouache on beige wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dimly lit room with a large lamp on a table in the foreground, casting light onto a sleeping figure in a bed and several objects including a jar, a cup, and possibly an artist's palette. The color palette consists mainly of black, white, and shades of brown, giving it a monochromatic appearance with warm tones. The lamp occupies the left side prominently, with the bed and the sleeping figure placed slightly further back in the center-right, while various items appear scattered on the table in front.

artworks.title: Triumphal Altar with Stages in the Life of Christ
artworks.medium: etching (iron) with open biting, plate bitten twice, on 2 joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (joined): 62.5 x 21.6 cm (24 5/8 x 8 1/2 in.)
sheet (top): 32 x 17.3 cm (12 5/8 x 6 13/16 in.)
sheet (bottom): 30.7 x 21.6 cm (12 1/16 x 8 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex architectural structure featuring religious iconography and figures. The drawing depicts a multi-tiered altar-like structure adorned with numerous intricately carved figures and symbols. At the base, a group of figures is seated in a gathering, surrounded by ornate columns and classical decorative elements. Above this scene, there is a depiction of a crucifixion with figures flanking each side, and further up, saints or ecclesiastical figures appear to be standing guard at the pinnacle of the structure. The entire composition is highly detailed, and the architectural elements are rich with leaves, masks, and other classical motifs. The vertical composition emphasizes the grandeur and intricate detailing of the structure.

artworks.title: Hercules Relieving Atlas of the Globe
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over brush and gray wash over chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing two men. One man is on the right, carrying a large sphere on his shoulders. This man is muscular, with short, curly hair, a short beard, and a toga partially covering his body. On the left, the other man is seated on a stone bench, looking at the man holding the sphere. This man has shorter hair and a longer beard, and he appears slightly older and is nude. The background features rolling hills, distant mountains, and patches of vegetation. A wide river curves across the landscape below, and there are some buildings along the water. The lines appear brown against the beige paper, with some areas of dark gray shading.

artworks.title: Program Design for the Théâtre Libre [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of Daryl Reich Rubenstein
artworks.description: The image displays an arrangement of curving lines and shapes with patches of vibrant colors on the left side of the canvas. A central form resembling the back of a human figure in soft yellows is surrounded by splashes of bold blues and greens. Amorphous yellow shapes on a blue background are situated above, while to the right, there is a small orange square shape with a muted red side.

artworks.title: Program Design for the Théâtre Libre [verso]
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of Daryl Reich Rubenstein
artworks.description: The image consists of flowing lines and loose shapes creating an abstract figure in soft yellow, highlighted with violet and blue strokes. The abstract composition suggests a human form reaching out, with bold brushstroke lines extending from the figure's side. Above and below, there are brush-lettered words echoing the painted figure's fluidity, resembling artistic script or splattered ink. Surrounding the figure and text are abstract strokes in various shades of purple and gray, with shapes at the bottom suggesting flames or another rising element.
